<function name="SetWhiteness" parent="Color" type="classfunc">
	<description>Converts a <page>Color</page> into [HWB color space](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HWB_color_model), sets the "whiteness" and converts it back into an RGB color.
</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<added>2025.01.23</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="whiteness" type="number">The new "whiteness" value in range [0, 1]</arg>
	</args>
</function>
